Name: Dunes

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the noise that bends dune ridges and creates secondary sand bands.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the spacing of dune ridges and the scale of their surface breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create more closely spaced dune variation.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Changes the phase and placement of dune variation without changing its overall scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different dune field.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends dune ridges so they meander instead of forming straight repeated lines.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more wind-shaped dune flow.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points used to break up dune bands.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local dune feature placement.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: Smoothness
Params.Label: Edge Smoothness
Params.Description: Controls how softly the shape transitions between regions.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values produce softer, less abrupt transitions.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: Distortion
Params.Description: Controls the amount of procedural warping applied to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Increase distortion for a less regular silhouette.

Params.Name: DistortionScale
Params.Label: Distortion Scale
Params.Description: Controls the size of the distortion pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create finer distortion.

Description: Generates a dunes-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
